title: Beauty and The Beast
description: A dark twist on the morality tale of forbidden love between beautiful Belle and the feared forest Beast. As villagers are brutally murdered and the Beast is hunted down as the one responsible for the mayhem, Belle and Beast team up to defeat the real killer; the power-hungry witch’s malevolent troll

title: Beauty and the Breast
description: Compelling insight into the reality of breast cancer, as seen through the eyes of nine female patients. Their individual stories demystify the deadly disease while painting intimate, often humorous portraits of struggle, survival and hope - including a unique perspective on prevention.

title: Behold My Heart
description: In this uplifting story about love and loss, a mother and son find their way forward in the face of adversity.

title: Beyond the Gates
description: Two estranged brothers reunite at their missing father's video store to liquidate the property and sell off his assets.

title: Billie
description: The definitive story of Billie Holiday, the world’s greatest and most controversial jazz singer, is now revealed through a wealth of never-before-heard taped interviews and research undertaken by the journalist Linda LipnackKuehl.

title: Black Plague
description: In 1348, with the horrors of the Black Death haunting Europe, English soldiers return home from war with a French nobleman as hostage. When people in their home village soon after begin to die, it is believed that the Black Death has struck once more.

title: Bliss
description: In this quirky love story, a divorced man meets a woman who is living on the streets and is convinced that the world around them is just a simulation.

title: Born to Fly
description: With breathtaking aerial sequences and high-stakes action, "Born to Fly" is an adrenaline-fueled ride that showcases the unwavering determination and bravery of test pilots.

title: Breaking Free
description: When a thirty-something 'suit' breaks into a music festival to retrieve his stolen belongings, he ends up finding love and freedom instead.

title: Breaking Infinity
description: A scientific researcher who has become unstuck in time must figure out what happened to him and stop the coming end of the world.

title: Broadcast Signal Intrusion
description: In the late 90s, a video archivist unearths a series of sinister pirate broadcasts and becomes obsessed with uncovering the conspiracy behind them.

title: Buffaloed
description: When an acceptance letter to the school of her dreams arrives, Peg falls into the shady business of delinquent debt collection to pay her tuition fees.

title: Bullet To Beijing
description: When British agent Harry Palmer loses his job because the Cold War is over, a Russian boss approaches him and tells Harry of his plan for Russia's future, which is threatened because a deadly biochemical weapon called the Red Death, has been stolen from him and he'll pay Harry to retrieve it.

title: Can You Keep A Secret?
description: On a return flight from a botched client meeting, Emma reveals all of her deepest secrets to a handsome stranger when her plane hits turbulence and she believes she is going to die. Emma thinks she will never see the guy again.

title: Cecil
description: Cecil's name reveals his lisp so he changes it to “Michael Jordan.” His school learns a lesson about acceptance after he and his friends start a business that sells celebrity names to kids.

title: Censor
description: When film censor Enid (Niamh Algar) is assigned to review a disturbing video nasty that recalls her sister’s mysterious disappearance, she resolves to unravel the puzzle behind the film and its enigmatic director - a quest that will blur the lines between fiction and reality in terrifying ways.

title: Charlie's Christmas Wish
description: Coming home from his last deployment, Sgt. Major John Frost arrives a month early and he’s happy to be home for Christmas.

title: Christmas on Holly Lane
description: Sarah, Cat and Riley reunite in Sarah’s childhood home to cook up some Christmas magic and save the holidays for their families. With each friend at a different crossroad, they will all have to come together to rediscover the Christmas magic that can only happen in the house on Holly Lane.

title: Clemency
description: Years of carrying out death row executions have taken a toll on prison warden, Bernadine Williams. The emotional wedge in her marriage grows. Memories of a recently botched execution plague her daily.

title: Cloned: The Recreator Chronicles
description: A group of teens find a secret lab and come face to face with exact duplicates of themselves. But what if your clone was a far superior version of yourself, would you kill it, or let it replace you?

title: Con Man
description: The unbelievable true story of Barry Minkow, the youngest person ever to defraud Wall Street and who by the age of 21 was worth a staggering 100 million dollars.

title: Crash
description: Los Angeles residents who live vastly separate lives collide in interweaving stories of race, loss and redemption.

title: Crazy Kind of Love
description: A newly single mother relies on her son and his carefree girlfriend to rebuild her belief in love, even if it is the crazy kind.

title: Darklands
description: A newspaper reporter is lured into a conspiracy of pagan rituals and human sacrifice when he investigates the death of a steelworker.

title: Deadly Cuts
description: Deadly Cuts follows the stylists of a Dublin hair salon who become accidental vigilantes as they take on a local gang threatening their community.

title: Diamond Dog Caper
description: A courageous boy battles a gang of bumbling thieves to rescue a dog carrying a fortune in stolen diamonds.

title: Disappearance at Lake Elrod
description: A year after the disappearance of Charlie's daughter, another girl from Elrod, Georgia, goes missing. Charlie believes the cases are connected.

title: Divorce: A Journey Through the Kids' Eyes
description: A powerful examination of the effects of divorce told by kids for kids that the whole family will benefit from. Experience insightful testimonies from children across the United States as they live through the initial trauma of divorce.

title: Dominion: The Last Star Warrior
description: In five days the world changed. As a retired Intelligence agent turned UFO investigator races to discover the fate of the human race, an alien observer searchs for the human woman he loves.

title: Donovan's Echo
description: Donovan Matheson is a man trapped in the past. Once an esteemed physicist, he worked on the Manhattan Project but in the years that followed, he became engulfed in regret, which soon turned into an obsession with finding a way to use his work to do good.

title: Double Take
description: A writer gets caught up in something dangerous after witnessing a crime and identifying the supposed perpetrator in a line-up.

title: Dumped
description: Eleven people are taking part in the ultimate eco-challenge – not in a jungle or desert island, but living on a rubbish dump in South London for three weeks.

title: Eating Our Way to Extinction
description: Narrated by Kate Winslet, this surprising documentary will challenge the way you look at the food industry with shocking undercover footage and poignant first-hand accounts. What is the true cost of food? Who pays the price?

title: Edge of War
description: A series of incidents around the world lead to greater conflict, placing the superpowers at one another's throats. Armies march, bombs rain down, soldiers storm the beaches. One family is caught up in the conflict, can they survive as total war is declared and nuclear weapons are unleashed?

title: Elite Force - B.R.I.
description: Homeless ex- soldiers from around the world are kidnapped and shipped to a mad scientist in London England who has plans to repair, restore and send them on dangerous missions to take vengeance against corruption around the world.

title: Encounter
description: A group of friends make a remarkable discovery in a rural field - a crashed spacecraft - And there's a survivor. But when they bring the otherworldly being home, they soon discover that it holds even greater secrets than they could imagine.

title: Even Money
description: Gambling addiction brings three strangers together as it destroys each of their lives.

title: Exit Speed
description: Strangers use improvised weapons, adrenaline and sheer guts to mount a defense against murderous bikers and their survival depends on doing the unthinkable - fighting for their lives!

title: Fart: A Documentary
description: Take an in-depth look into the history, social and interpersonal issues surrounding farting. Why does it trigger laughter? What is the difference between male and female farts? Why does it happen? And is it more socially acceptable now?

title: Fear of Rain
description: Fear of Rain is a twisty, unsettling and terrifying horror thriller starring Katherine Heigl (Knocked Up, Firefly Lane), Madison Iseman (Jumanji franchise, Annabelle Comes Home) and Harry Connick Jr. (PS. I Love You), that will keep you guessing whether there is real horror hiding next door.

title: Finding Ms. Right
description: Two childhood friends reunite as adults to help each other land the women of their dreams.

title: Finding Steve McQueen
description: Based on the true story of the Youngstown mob, President Richard Nixon, the FBI, and the biggest bank heist in US history! In 1972, a gang of likeminded thieves plan a heist to steal $30 million in illegal campaign contributions from the President's secret fund.

title: First Snow
description: A psychic's ominous predictions send a man into a tailspin.

title: Fitting In
description: In this coming-of-age drama, 16 year-old Lindy's life plans are thrown off course when she is diagnosed with a life changing reproductive condition. In coming to terms with the news she must rethink her presumptions about womanhood, her relationships and her sense of self.

title: Foster Boy
description: A for-profit Foster care agency puts a known sex offender into the same foster home as a lawyer's young client, Jamal, with catastrophic results.

title: Give Them Wings
description: Give Them Wings is based on the true story of wheelchair bound Paul Hodgson. A man who fought back and won.

title: God's Soldier
description: An Orphaned Child with a price on her head seeks refuge in a Chapel run by a beautiful Nun, but all is not what it seems. High Octane action as they flee the clutches of a Rogue CIA Agent.

title: Gold
description: In the not too distant future, a drifter travelling through the desert discovers the largest gold nugget ever found. He must guard it from thieves amid harsh conditions and wild dogs while waiting for his partner to return.

title: Great British Garden Revival
description: In Great British Garden Revival, Britain’s top television gardeners have come together on a joint mission to switch us back to being a population that’s proud of its roses and rockeries, hedgerows and herb gardens, water features and wildflowers.

title: Greener Grass
description: GREENER GRASS is a hilariously deadpan hellscape of competitive suburbia with a boldly stylized absurdist chain of events that unfurls with increasing fervour after one soccer mom gifts another her infant daughter just to be polite.

title: Grey Matter
description: Teenager Chloe has never been close with her Nan Peg but when she gets diagnosed with Alzheimer's and moves into the family home, Chloe's forced to become her stay-at-home carer overnight.

title: Gun Shy
description: The story follows Turk Henry; a mega platinum rock star who's married to a supermodel and rich beyond his wildest dreams. Whilst on holiday, his wife is mysteriously abducted by a group of renegade, ship-less pirates.

title: Guns, Girls and Gambling
description: Five Elvis impersonators are hunted by assassins when a valuable Elvis mask is stolen from a casino.

title: Habit
description: When a drug deal goes wrong, street smart party girl Mads and her best friends find a possible way out by masquerading as nuns.

title: Hard Kill
description: A team of fearless mercenaries, led by security expert Derek Miller, are considered the best fighters on Earth that money can buy. They are strategically hired by billionaire tech CEO Donovan Chalmers to protect a piece of technology that, if exposed, could destroy the world.

title: Hard Night Falling
description: A criminal mastermind, has come up with a plot to steal a fortune from the Rossini family villa during a party hosted by them. Unbeknownst to him and his crew, one of Rossini's guests is a highly trained foreign operative who will fight to the death to save the hostages and his family.

title: Havoc
description: A group of wealthy Los Angeles teenagers try to become part of the "gangsta" lifestyle but soon run into trouble when they come face to face with a real gang of Latino drug dealers.

title: Heidi
description: Heidi is based on the novel by Johanna Spyri.  The film follows the adventures of Heidi, a young orphan girl, whose gift for happiness helps her when she is forced to leave the mountains for a new life in the city.

title: Her Magical Christmas
description: Marie Kendrick used to be the ‘Christmas Queen’ until she had her heart broken by her first love at Christmas.To help, her family decide to give her a box of Christmas ornaments to lift her spirits. Like magic, great things start to happen… a promotion, a hot date!

title: Hole
description: Two con artists seduce and rob lonely women. But things go terribly wrong when they accidentally kill one of their victims and try to bury her body in the woods.

title: Honeymoon
description: Jorge, an eccentric and lonely medical doctor, kidnaps Isabel his neighbour in an apparent effort to submit her to a classical conditioning experiment to make her his woman.....but appearances often hide a more terrifying truth.

title: Hope Dances
description: A multi-talented young girl must choose between pursuing her mother's dream of her becoming a prima ballerina and her father's aspirations of making her a sports champion.

title: I Can Only Imagine
description: It's the song that brings ultimate hope to so many...often in the midst of life s most challenging moments.

title: I Heart Willie
description: An obsessed psychopath unknowingly leads her friends into a deadly mousetrap where pure evil seeks to harvest their skin, in this horrific origin story of the most beloved cartoon character of modern times.

title: I Love You Phillip Morris
description: A cop turns con man once he comes out of the closet. Once imprisoned, he meets the second love of his life, whom he'll stop at nothing to be with.

title: Incendies
description: Canadian twins Jeanne and Simon, are left two envelopes in their mother's will asking them to find a brother and father they never knew they had.

title: Incoming
description: The International Space Station is now a prison - the ultimate black site. No one's getting out. And no one knows it's there. But when the imprisoned terrorists take over the Station and turn it into a missile aimed at Moscow, only a shuttle pilot and a rookie doctor can stop them.

title: Infamous
description: Two young lovers rob their way across America, posting their crimes on social media, and gaining fame and followers as a result.

title: Instrument of War
description: Instrument Of War is an harrowing yet uplifting true story about survival against seemingly impossible odds. When U.S. B-24 bomber pilot Clair Cline is shot down and captured in northern Germany, one war ends and another begins -- to keep hope alive.

title: InterReflections
description: In a quest for a new, more humane society, a counter-culture revolution takes the world by storm.

title: Jack Strong
description: Based on a true story of how a Polish colonel defied the Soviet Union to become a double agent for the CIA.  In the process, he avoided all-out nuclear war and helped to end the Cold War.

title: Jackdaw
description: A former motocross champion and army veteran embarks on a violent nocturnal odyssey while searching for his kidnapped brother across North East England.

title: Jobs
description: Ashton Kutcher is Steve Jobs, the iconic Apple innovator and groundbreaking entrepreneur. This inspiring and entertaining film chronicles Jobs early days as a college dropout, to his rise as the co-founder of Apple Computer Inc.

title: Johnny Mnemonic
description: It’s the year 2021 and data courier (Keanu Reeves) is in a race against time to deliver a dangerous stash of information in his head to save himself.

title: Juniper
description: Troubled teenager, Sam, has been on a self-destructive streak, so bad that it could have resulted in his own death. Returning home from boarding school he discovers that his wheelchair-bound English grandmother, Ruth, has moved in with them.

title: Kids In America
description: A diverse group of high school students band together to peacefully stick it to their overbearing principal.

title: Killing Gunther
description: A dysfunctional team of young assassins set out to make a name for themselves by killing the most notorious hitman of all time, Gunther (Arnold Schwarzenegger).

title: Kobe: The Legend of the 81-Point Game
description: A documentary that looks at the life of Los Angeles Lakers forward and guard Kobe Bryant. The film tells the player's story on and off the court through firsthand narratives and exclusive archival footage and photos.

title: Lapsis
description: Black Mirror meets Birdbox, Lapsis is an innovative, engagingly topical, darkly funny and breathlessly creative piece of sci-fi cinema.

title: Legendary
description: Travis and his team travel to China in search of what isn't supposed to exist... their mission to capture a Cryptid which is wreaking havoc in a remote village and they need to do this before it is killed by Harker, the legendary bounty hunter.

title: Listen To Your Heart
description: A singer/songwriter falls in love with a girl who can't hear the music she inspires him to write.

title: Little Buddha
description: After the death of Lama Dorje, Tibetan Buddhist monks find three children who may be the rebirth of their great teacher.

title: Looks Like Christmas
description: From cooking to decorating, Carol sleeps and breathes Christmas, so it’s no wonder the town refers to her as “Christmas Carol” but when a handsome man comes to town and challenges her traditional holiday views, Carol must learn how to compromise even if it means facing an unexpected romance.

title: Lost in the Pacific
description: A luxury airline is making its maiden flight, with a group of VIP passengers on board, when disaster strikes. A mechanical failure forces the plane to crash land and it ends up on a remote Pacific island where passengers and crew must wait to be rescued.

title: Love Wrecked
description: Jenny Taylor has found her ideal man who she just knows would sweep her off her feet. The only problem?

title: Lucky Number
description: A young man's life is on a losing streak, until he gets the old cell number of a major basketball star, and starts using it to get VIP access to A-List parties... Until his idol finds out.

title: Lying and Stealing
description: Ivan, a successful art thief, and Elyse, an actress and con-woman, team up to pull off a heist which won't make them rich, but will set them free.

title: Machine Gun Preacher
description: The story of Sam Childers, a former drug-dealing biker tough guy who found God and became a crusader for hundreds of Sudanese children who've been forced to become soldiers.

title: Magic Beyond Words
description: An inspiring look at JK Rowling's rise to become one of the most influential writers-from her humble beginnings, as an imaginative young girl and awkward teenager, to the loss of her mother and the genesis of the Harry Potter phenomenon.

title: MaMa
description: In the aftermath of a tragedy a woman, Magda, reacts with a surge of newfound life that engulfs her circle of family and friends.

title: Maniac
description: The terrifying story of a lone serial killer who stalks women before scalping them to add to his collection of mannequins.

title: Margin Call
description: Margin Call is an entangling thriller involving the key players at an investment firm during one perilous 24-hour period in the early stages of the 2008 financial crisis. Decisions both financial and moral catapult the lives of all involved to the brink of disaster

title: Match Point
description: "Match Point" is a drama about ambition, the seduction of wealth, love, and sexual passion. Perhaps most importantly, however, the story reveals the huge part luck plays in events, refuting the comforting misconception that more of life is under our control than really is.

title: Maximum Impact
description: Since the days of the Cold War, Russian-American relations have been strained.  To ease this situation, the US Secretary of State goes to a secret summit meeting in Moscow where the leader of an international gang makes an attempt on his life and kidnaps his granddaughter.

title: Meteor
description: Ten years after a meteor collides into Earth causing a worldwide flood, a lonely rancher named Liam lives a quiet, private life on his farm away from others. One day while on a hunt, Liam finds Olivia, a troubled young lady, running for her life on the outskirts of his fields.

title: Meteor: First Impact
description: William Zito, a recently fired weather scientist, has stolen Russian research, which pinpoints the exact time and location of a deadly meteor attack.

title: Mid90s
description: Written and directed by Jonah Hill, Mid90s follows Stevie, a thirteen-year-old in 90s-era LA who spends his summer navigating between his troubled home life and a group of new friends that he meets at a Motor Avenue skate shop.

title: Mile 22
description: In a visceral modern thriller from the director of Lone Survivor, Mark Wahlberg stars as James Silva, an operative of the CIA’s most highly-prized and least-understood unit.

title: Misconduct
description: When an ambitious lawyer takes on a big case against a ruthless executive he soon finds himself caught in a web of blackmail and corruption.

title: Miss Me This Christmas
description: Regina moves into her friend’s suite at The Chesterton Hotel as she waits for her divorce settlement to come through on Christmas Day. While there, she starts a whirlwind romance with a billionaire, who proposes to her.

title: Monster
description: Based on the life of Aileen Wuornos, a Daytona Beach prostitute who became a serial killer.

title: Monsters
description: Six years ago NASA discovered the possibility of alien life within our solar system. A probe was launched to collect samples, but crashed upon re-entry over Central America. Soon after, new life forms began to appear and half of Mexico was quarantined as an infected zone.

title: Mother Father Sister Brother Frank
description: A suburban family plots murder when an uncle crashes Sunday dinner with a nasty surprise.

title: Motherhood
description: Over the course of one explosive evening, two couples and a surrogate must face their own ridiculous and sometimes heartbreaking shortcomings.

title: Mr Doom - Behind the 8 ball
description: Jack and Charlie are an unlikely pair on a dangerous path to self destruction in a world of their own design. Both struggling to keep up a bygone lifestyle that revolves around a green felt table with six pockets and sixteen balls.

title: Murder On The Cape
description: Based on the true story of New York fashion writer Christa Worthington who has an affair during a winter in Cape Cod.She later returns with his child. When she is murdered, a mystery unfolds.

title: Mythica: A Quest for Heroes
description: Mythica follows the enchanting adventures of Marek, a wizard born with the dark powers of necromancy, trapped in a life of eternal servitude. With the help of beautiful a priestess, Teela...

title: Mythica: Necromancer
description: Mallister takes Thane prisoner and forces Marek and her team on a quest.

title: Mythica: The Dragon Slayer
description: As the Lich King's zombie legions ravage the world, Marek, a cursed young sorceress, embarks on a quest to obtain a weapon from the gods, with her friend Dagen, a self-serving half-elf rogue

title: Mythica: The Iron Crown
description: Good and evil battle it out in the fourth gripping adventure from the fantastical franchise. When daring young wizard Marek steals the final piece of the all-powerful Darkspore she embarks on a desperate quest to deliver the cursed artefact to the gods.

title: Nazi Undead
description: A young American couple venture into the heartland of Germany for a romantic holiday. Things take a sinister turn when they encounter a Nazi SS Officer at an isolated farmhouse thrusting them into a vortex of horror.

title: Nemesis
description: Underworld kingpin John Morgan (Billy Murray) returns to London from his perfect life abroad, reigniting a feud with vengeful cop Frank Conway (Nick Moran) who is obsessed with bringing him down and setting in motion a power play with his brother (Frank Harper).

title: No Letting Go
description: Based on a true story. When a young boy begins to struggle with anxiety, depression and mood disorder, his mother goes on a desperate quest to help her middle son cope with life.

title: No Man's Land
description: One mistake will change everything. For one family protecting their land on the Texas-Mexico border is everything but one night when confronted with an immigrant family illegally crossing the border Jackson accidentally kills a young boy.

title: Nothing But The Truth
description: Nothing but the Truth is an edge-of-your-seat political thriller starring Kate Beckinsale, Vera Farmiga and Matt Dillon. Washington DC political journalist Rachel Armstrong writes an explosive story about a government scandal in which she reveals the name of a covert CIA agent.

title: Omniscient Reader: The Prophecy
description: Kim Dokja, an ordinary office worker in his 20s, seems to be the only reader of an obscure apocalyptic web novel. The day he finishes the final chapter, the story comes to life — and its omnipotent protagonist Yu Junghyeok appears before him.

title: One Under the Sun
description: Kathryn Voss, the only survivor of an international Mars mission, is separated from her family and forced to go on the run when the government discovers she has returned with an extraordinary power that could end war.

title: Only Lovers Left Alive
description: A depressed musician reunites with his lover, though their romance - which has already endured several centuries - is disrupted by the arrival of her uncontrollable younger sister.

title: Out of Death
description: Still grieving the untimely death of her father, photojournalist Shannon Mathers spreads his ashes in the woods when she witnesses a cop shooting and killing an unarmed henchman during a drug deal. She captures the whole scene on her camera before being discovered.

title: People I Know
description: A press agent (Al Pacino) is lead into the murky world of political conspiracy and murder when his major client becomes embroiled in a huge scandal.

title: Pinocchio
description: Live-action adaptation of the beloved story of a wooden puppet named Pinocchio who magically comes to life.

title: Point Man
description: A trio of soldiers vow revenge on their platoon when they are left behind enemy lines. When they come across a contingent, alliances dissolve and each step forward comes with a price.

title: Poltergeist
description: In this terrifying take on a classic, a suburban family tormented by inter-dimensional spirits must save their daughter from being lost to the ghosts forever!

title: Pretenders
description: Life imitates deadly art as French New Wave obsessed film student Terry (Jack Kilmer, The Nice Guys) and his best friend, the smooth talking Phil (Shameik Moore, Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse) are both seduced by mysterious actress Catherine (Jane Levy, Evil Dead ).

title: Prime
description: A career driven professional from Manhattan is wooed by a young painter, who also happens to be the son of her psychoanalyst.

title: Prisoner's Daughter
description: Released from prison with terminal cancer, Max tries to reconnect with his estranged daughter and the grandson he's never known. When his daughter's abusive, drug-addicted ex-husband reappears, Max's violent past comes back to haunt them all.

title: R.A.D.A.R.: The Adventures of the Bionic Dog
description: A boy and his dog with bionic powers save a small town from two bumbling crooks.

title: Rag Doll
description: Can a rising female star of Mixed Martial Arts use success to temper the violence in her life outside of the ring?

title: Rani Rani Rani
description: Rani, a caretaker at an abandoned factory, is lured by a group of opportunists with a mysterious device and becomes trapped in a time loop with her husband on one hand, and his brother and ruthless sister-in-law on the other.

title: Rebel in the Rye
description: The story of the life and mind of the legendary author J.D. Salinger and the events that led to the birth of his iconic book The Catcher in the Rye.

title: Ride On
description: Action legend Jackie Chan (Vanguard, Rush Hour, Police Story) is back in an action-packed and heart-warming tribute to the world of stunts which made him an international superstar. Luo (Chan) is a washed-up stuntman whose glory days are far behind him.

title: Road Wars: Max Fury
description: In a post-apocalyptic wasteland, two sisters leave their stronghold to save their wounded mother. Armed only with a muscle car and limited ammo, they race against ruthless raiders to secure lifesaving supplies from a distant outpost.

title: Robot Overlords
description: The adults lost the war and now the kids must save the world! Robots rule the streets and the people are locked in their homes. Stepping outside risks being vaporised by a hulking Sentry or picked off by a lethal Sniper.

title: Round the Decay
description: A young woman returns to the site of her broken engagement, Newport's Valley, a sleepy tourist town with an all-consuming secret.

title: Salt and fire
description: A scientist blames the head of a large company for an ecological disaster in South America. But when a volcano begins to show signs of erupting, they must unite to avoid a disaster.

title: Salvation Boulevard
description: Set in the world of mega churches in which a former Deadhead turned born again Christian finds himself on the run from fundamentalist members of his mega church who will do anything to protect their larger than life pastor.

title: Saving Christmas
description: In this clever, crazy family adventure starring comedy legend Edward Asner, Danny and his brainy buddies launch an "X-Files"-style investigation to discover the truth about Santa. But they have no clue that St. Nick (Asner) is real—and he's making toys right in their hometown!

title: Scarlet Winter
description: A married man wakes with a bloody knife in his hand and his dead mistress in his bed. At first convinced of his guilt, he buries the body, but as he pieces together the events of the night before, he believes he is being framed and there is a murderer among the people closest to him.

title: Scoop
description: An American journalism student in London scoops a big story, and begins an affair with an aristocrat as the incident unfurls.

title: Shark Attack
description: In this savage seaside horror, a marine biologist hunts for answers when his friend becomes the latest victim of a series of brutal shark attacks.

title: Sharknado 5: Global Swarming
description: With much of America lying in ruins, the rest of the world braces for a global sharknado, and Fin and his family must travel around the world to stop them.

title: Shattered Earth. Cloudy Mountain
description: A peaceful town turns into a living hell when a devastating earthquake is triggered, causing buildings to tumble and sinkholes to open. A retired railway soldier and his son, an explosives engineer, travel deep into a cave to rescue trapped survivors.

title: Shock Wave: Hong Kong Destruction
description: A disgruntled former bomb disposal officer Poon (Andy Lau, Infernal Affairs, House of Flying Daggers) , who awakes from a coma with amnesia, becomes a fugitive when the police suspect him of being involved in bomb attacks.

title: Silent Night
description: Recently released from prison and struggling to find work, Mark meets Alan, his former cell-mate, who encourages him to return to a life of crime.

title: Sinbad and The Fifth Voyage
description: When an evil sorcerer, known as the White Thief, kidnaps Firoozeh and holds her hostage in the Black Desert, Sinbad has 40 days and 40 nights to rescue her.

title: Skin
description: A black child born to white parents is cast out of white society in 1950s South Africa. The film follows her thirty-year journey to acceptance.

title: Skyman
description: The story of Carl who believes he experienced an alien encounter at 10-years-old and is now trying to reconnect with the UFO as the same location.

title: Sliding Doors
description: Helen is fired from her job at a PR company. While returning home, she misses the train, but in a parallel universe, she catches the train, which triggers a completely different turn of events.

title: Snow White and the Seven Samurai
description: Left for dead by her rich and powerful stepmother, Snow White is taken in by a team of assassins - The Seven Samurai, who train her in their ways of fighting.

title: Sox: A Family's Best Friend
description: A new family is struggling when a new dog comes into their life. Once his special powers are discovered, the local dog catcher and the (F.B.D.I) Federal Bureau of Dog Investigation try to capture him.

title: Spy Intervention
description: When a top-secret super spy suddenly meets the woman of his dreams, he abandons his adventurous existence and settles for the security of suburbia, revelling in the quaint existence he's never known. One year later, he is completely bored, though he refuses to admit it.

title: Stardust
description: Chronicles the young David Bowie's first visit to the US in 1971 - a trip that inspired the invention of his iconic alter ego, Ziggy Stardust.

title: Stephen King's A Good Marriage
description: From the legendary Stephen King, author of 'Misery' and 'The Shining', comes this year's most terrifying thriller. Thinking bad things only happen to others, Darcy soon finds out the truth as she uncovers a gruesome truth about her husband that suddenly makes the outside world frightening real.

title: Storm Rider: Legend of Hammerhead
description: Three centuries after the Great Flood, the land has been reduced to many islands, perpetually menaced by a colossal Storm. The Islanders' only hope for safety lies in the city-state of Argos, attainable through dangerous competitions known as Storm Riding.

title: Strawberry Mansion
description: In the near future an unassuming dream tax auditor gets swept up in a cosmic journey through the life and dreams of an ageing eccentric.

title: Sweet Autumn
description: Maggie, a successful entrepreneur, returns home for a will reading and discovers she’s inherited half of her aunt’s famed maple candy business. What she doesn’t understand is why Aunt Dee’s maple supplier, Dex, inherited the other half.

title: Tailor-Made Romance
description: A struggling designer takes a job as a personal stylist for a grumpy but ridiculously handsome billionaire. As she revamps his wardrobe and he teaches her about business, they realize they just might be the perfect fit.

title: Ted Bundy American Boogeyman
description: Ted Bundy stalks the highways of gritty 70s America. FBI agents lead the largest manhunt in history to apprehend America's most infamous serial killer.

title: Tell It Like a Woman
description: Academy Award nominated Tell It Like A Woman tells the empowering stories of women, both in front of and behind the camera.

title: The Assassination
description: There is something, or someone, rotten at St Donavan's High School, and Bobby is determined to uncover the dirty truth.

title: The Baby Snatcher
description: Best friends become pregnant at the same time. However, when one of them suffers a miscarriage, jealousy turns her into a murderous baby snatcher.

title: The Believer
description: Ryan Gosling stars in the true story of an anti-Semitic skinhead who was revealed to be Jewish by a New York Times reporter.

title: The Boy, The Dog, and The Clown
description: A young boy, Adrien, grieving over the loss of his father, befriends a down-on-his-luck clown who performs incredible feats of magic. When the boy gets lost in the woods, he ultimately realizes that he must use the magical powers taught to him by the clown in order to be rescued.

title: The Christmas Cure
description: When Vanessa Thompson, a hard-working doctor, returns home for Christmas, but she is up for a huge promotion back at work! However, she is torn between taking the job, or staying home to take over the family clinic.

title: The Clovehitch Killer
description: A picture-perfect family is shattered when the work of a serial killer hits too close to home.

title: The Cooler
description: The unluckiest man in Vegas - a guy whose bad luck is contagious is used by the last of the old mob run casinos to kill high rollers' action. That is, until he falls in love with a cocktail waitress and gets "lady luck", which throws the situation into reverse.

title: The Crossroads
description: Ex-cowboy war vet with PTSD meets hitchhiking singer/songwriter with trust issues. He shows her simpler life, they bond over inner demons. Develop relationship after finding commonalities in each other's struggles.

title: The Dead Mothers Club
description: Three women bound by the shared experience of having lost their mothers during adolescence yet whose paths never cross.

title: The Eight Hundred
description: Shanghai 1937. It's been 3 months since Japan launched the invasion of China and Japanese forces have to take down the Si Hang Warehouse without further delay.

title: The Happy Elf
description: Based on Grammy®-winner Harry Connick, Jr.'s original song, this family comedy follows one of Santa's helpers whose overly optimistic outlook is put to the test when he decides to bring Christmas joy to a sad little town called Bluesville.

title: The Happytime Murders
description: An innovative film that incorporates influences from multiple genres to create a hilarious hybrid of film noir, crime drama, and cop buddy picture — with a healthy dose of R-Rated profanity and humor.

title: The Haunting of Sharon Tate
description: Haunted by visions of her impending death, Hollywood actress Sharon Tate (Hilary Duff) tries to convince her friends that something terrible is about to happen, in the hopes of changing her destiny.

title: The Healer
description: As much as Alec yearns to avoid being attributed any healing powers, more bizarre events keep occurring. Alec, in shock, is discovering the family secret he possesses, a gift… the gift of healing, a gift he must accept or reject.

title: The Heist
description: It was a stroke of genius, but now the perfect crime is turning into a perfect disaster.

title: The Human Centipede (First Sequence)
description: Two pretty American girls on a road trip across Europe end up alone in the woods at night when their car breaks down in rural Germany. As they search for help they find an isolated house. Offering to call them a taxi the houses owner Dr. Heiter, a retired surgeon, invites the girls inside...

title: The Human Centipede 2 (Full Sequence)
description: To escape his dreary existence, Martin loses himself in the fantasy world of the cult horror film The Human Centipede, fetishizing the meticulous surgical skills of the gifted Dr. Heiter, whose knowledge of the human gastrointestinal system inspires Martin to attempt the unthinkable.

title: The Human Centipede 3 (Final Sequence)
description: Re-uniting the stars of the first two films The Human Centipede 3 (Final Sequence) is the finale the worlds sickest horror franchise deserves. Nasty, revolting, and utterly deplorable.

title: The Hummingbird Project
description: A pair of high-frequency traders go up against their old boss in an effort to make millions in a fibre-optic cable deal.

title: The Imposters
description: Maya meets the enigmatic Hattie. They fall for each other, but soon, things begin to unravel as Maya realises that Hattie has ulterior motives and everything is not as it seems.

title: The Invisible Raptor
description: A failed experiment unleashes an invisible raptor. Now, a disgraced paleontologist, his ex, a crazed guard and a farmer must stop the unseen killer.

title: The Journey
description: After 40 years of "The Troubles" in Northern Ireland the leading players meet at St. Andrews to try and hammer out a final and lasting peace agreement.

title: The Killer
description: Ui-gang is a retired hitman. While his wife goes on a trip with her friend, she asks him a special favour to take care of her friend's daughter.

title: The Last Heist
description: From the Producers of Once Upon a Time in London comes The Last Heist. Four old school villains, Waldorf, Prozac, Fisherman and Slips plan one 'Last Heist' to liberate the key to the recently past away, head of South London crime family, Mick.

title: The Long Shadow
description: A young Sheriff's Deputy in rural Louisiana takes on her town's wealthiest family when the woman she's in a secret relationship with is murdered.

title: The Moogai
description: A young Aboriginal couple brings home their second baby. What should be a joyous time takes a sinister turn, as the baby's mother starts seeing a malevolent spirit she is convinced is trying to take her baby.

title: The Nanny
description: A wealthy couple hire a young girl from Finland to take care of their newborn. These new parents should be in a state of bliss, so why does it seem like they are trying to kill each other?

title: The Night Clerk
description: Hotel night clerk Bart Bromley (Tye Sheridan - READY PLAYER ONE), a highly intelligent young man on the Autism spectrum, uses covert surveillance cameras to record guests in efforts to improve his social interaction skills.

title: The Pebble and the Boy
description: A boy, his Dad’s ashes and a Lambretta scooter. John embarks on a journey from Manchester to Brighton, the spiritual home of the Mods. Featuring music by Paul Weller.

title: The Philadelphia Experiment
description: David Herdeg and Jim Parker are assigned a project to make an invisible radar. However, during the mission, an unusual incident occurs, transporting the two of them into the future.

title: The Pirate
description: The Pirate is the epic true story of Ioannis Varvakis, a humble Greek pirate who, with the help of Catherine The Great, went on to become an international caviar millionaire but ended his days as an inmate on a remote prison island.

title: The Poseidon Explosion
description: An ocean liner’s cargo of fertilizer ignites, causing an explosion which sets the whole ship ablaze. As the crew and passengers are plunged into a fiery fight for survival, an unlikely duo – a heroic newlywed and a resourceful stowaway – rally to help the stricken survivors.

title: The Professor and the Madman
description: Professor James Murray (Mel Gibson) begins work compiling words for the first edition of the Oxford English Dictionary in the 19th century, and receives over 10,000 entries from a patient at Broadmoor Criminal Lunatic Asylum, Dr. William Chester Minor (Sean Penn).

title: The Rest of Us
description: Four women must contend with their own grief, truths, flaws and secrets while ultimately deciding if the past will dictate their future.

title: The Resurrection of Charles Manson
description: While a couple creates an audition tape for an up-and-coming Charles Manson film, the dark events of the audition material slowly slip into their reality as they find themselves intertwined in an occult leader's sinister plot.

title: The Ride
description: The inspiring story of a BMX champion who overcame an abusive childhood through the love and life lessons of his foster family.

title: The Runner
description: In the wake of the BP oil spill Colin Price rockets to political stardom. But when his extra marital affair is exposed, his wife leaves him and his career is in ruins.

title: The Skulls
description: A senior at an ivy league college, who depends on scholarships and working on the side, gets accepted into the secret society The Skulls. He hopes it betters chances at Harvard but The Skulls is not what he thought and comes at a price.

title: The Swordsman
description: After the fall of King Gwanghae, Joseon's greatest swordsman and royal guard Tae-yul is forced into hiding. In the meantime, Joseon is caught between the Qing and Ming dynasties' conflict, and is at the mercy of Qing's envoy and slave trader Kurutai's ridiculous demands.

title: The Three Musketeers
description: France is in turmoil and a new, naive King finds himself manipulated by the evil Cardinal Richelieu (James Cosmo, Tom Clancy’s Jack Ryan).

title: The Tracker
description: Ten years ago, Aiden Hakansson's wife and daughter were kidnapped and killed in Italy during an exchange of prisoners gone wrong. Since then, Aiden has been living in the USA, isolated from the world, woken every night by nightmares and memories.

title: The Void
description: When police officer Carter discovers a blood-soaked man limping down a deserted road, he rushes him to a local hospital. As cloaked, cult-like figures surround the building, the patients and staff inside start to turn ravenously insane.

title: The Warrior Queen of Jhansi
description: The Warrior Queen of Jhansi tells the true story of the legendary Rani (translation: Queen) of Jhansi, a fearless freedom fighter in India. In 1857, this 24-year old General led her people into battle against the British Empire.

title: The Way We Weren't
description: When Charlotte and Brandon meet, they rush into marriage after failing in previous relationships. Then they discover who they’ve vowed to spend the rest of their lives with for better or worse.

title: Things Like This
description: When two guys with the same name start falling in love it seems like everything has aligned for them to be together. But is fate ever exactly how you expect it to be?

title: Three Wise Guys
description: "Twas the night before Christmas" and Murray Crown, owner of the Regal Crown Casino, is spreading anything but Chrismas cheer. To keep his accountant, Leo, from ratting him out to the feds, Murray hires three hit men, wise guys, to shut him up.

title: Transmission
description: Whilst channel surfing on TV late one night it becomes clear that different stories on different channels are all connected, parts of the same story - a story that must never be told, containing footage that must never be seen.

title: Under The Crystal Sky
description: In the 1800s, in the American Southwest, an Indigenous family witness a UFO crash near their home. Following the extraterrestrial event, strange occurrences transpire around them. The family must confront their fear of the extraterrestrial while also fending off the encroaching American military.

title: Val
description: A criminal on the run breaks into the home of a high class escort, only to discover that Val is a woman with a demonic twist.

title: Vampire Wars
description: In the wake of the American Civil War two vampires rise and fight to reclaim their land from the inhabitants of a sleepy Southern town.

title: Vampire's Kiss
description: When an encounter with a mysterious beauty (Jennifer Beals) leaves volatile literary agent Peter Loew (Nicholas Cage) convinced that he is turning into a vampire, his behavior turns positively outrageous as he begins to live the vampiric role.

title: Variant
description: When an artist struggling for purpose meets a mysterious yet charming stranger, she becomes entangled in his twisted attempts to 'relive the perfect moment'.

title: Vicky Cristina Barcelona
description: Vicky Cristina Barcelona has become one of the most talked about movies of the year. A sizzling, erotically charged, relentlessly hilarious and touching romantic comedy.

title: Waiting For The Barbarians
description: The Magistrate, administrator of an isolated frontier settlement on the border of an unnamed empire, looks forward to an easy retirement until the arrival of Colonel Joll, whose task it is to report on the activities of the 'barbarians' and on the security situation on the border.

title: Walkaway Joe
description: In the tradition of American classics, WALKAWAY JOE is the story of an unlikely friendship between a young boy searching for his father, and a wandering loner hiding from his past. In each other they experience the power of a second chance, and a shot at redemption.

title: Walt Before Mickey
description: The legendary Walt Disney had a tumultuous childhood, yet he was determined to overcome obstacles in his path, before the creation of his first iconic character: Mickey Mouse.

title: What Doesn't Kill You
description: What Doesn’t Kill You follows the story of two childhood friends Brian and Paulie. The pair have grown up on the tough and unforgiving streets of South Boston doing whatever they can to survive in the dog-eat-dog neighborhood and ultimately falling under the sway of a powerful crime boss.

title: Whispering Pines
description: A small town community comes together to eradicate the heroin epidemic from its midst by whatever means necessary.

title: White God
description: White God is a stunning allegory of the oppressed few savagely fighting back against their privileged abusers.

title: Winter Passing
description: A publishing agent offers a struggling actress and bartender $100,000 for a series of letters between her late mother and novelist father. Returning home to retrieve them, she finds her father living in the garage while two strangers live in the house.

title: Winter Ridge
description: A young detective is torn apart after his wife ends up in a coma. Unable to accept her condition, he throws himself into a manhunt chasing a serial killer whose motives are connected to his wife.

title: Wolf Warrior 2
description: China's deadliest Special Forces operative, known as the Wolf Warrior (Wu Jing - Call of Heroes, Kill Zone) is lying low.

title: Yes, God, Yes
description: Growing up in the Midwest in the early OOs, sixteen-year-old Alice has always been a good Catholic. But when an innocent AOL chat turns racy, she discovers masturbation and is overwhelmed with guilt. Seeking redemption, she attends a mysterious religious retreat to try and suppress her urges...

title: You Can't Fight Christmas
description: Interior designer Leslie Major loves all things Christmas. When she meets handsome Edmund James, she quickly learns he thinks the festivities are frivolous and superficial. Determined to change his mind, Leslie works her Christmas magic on him, and the unlikely couple fall in love along the way.

title: Alien Gods: The Shining Ones and Serpent Kings
Anpanman: Nanda and Runda From the Star of Toys
Asalto al banco de St. Louis (Doblado)
I Could Never Be Your Woman
King Arthur: Legend of the Sword
Blue Planet
description: David Attenborough narrates a natural history of the oceans.

title: Caribbean with Simon Reeve
description: Simon Reeve travels around the edge of the Caribbean Sea in this stunning series.

title: Emma
description: Sandy Welch's dramatisation of Jane Austen's novel, stars Romola Garai in the title role.

title: Mandy
description: A hapless heroine (Diane Morgan) embarks on adventures which mostly end in disaster.

title: Nazi Killing Fields
description: Documentary examining the horrific Arnsberg Forest massacre during WWII.

title: Steptoe and Son
description: Classic British sitcom about a father and son in the rag and bone trade in London.

title: Tess of the D'Urbervilles
description: Four-part drama series based on the novel by Thomas Hardy, written by David Nicholls

title: That Mitchell and Webb Look
description: Comedy sketch show starring David Mitchell and Robert Webb.

title: The Battle of Britain
description: An in-depth look at one of the most pivotal battles of the war.

title: The Good Place
description: Comedy about a dead woman who is sent to a heaven-like utopia by mistake.

title: The Two Ronnies
description: Sketch show featuring the double act of Ronnie Barker and Ronnie Corbett.

title: Wild China
description: Documentary exposing the wonderful creatures that live in China's beautiful landscapes

title: Yes Minister
description: Satirical sitcom set in the office of a UK government Cabinet minister, Jim Hacker MP

title: Yes, Prime Minister
description: Sitcom sequel to Yes, Minister, focusing on Jim Hacker's elevation to 10 Downing Street
